svg.title: The success ladder of the paper
svg.desc: Three steps rising to the right. Step one, refractivity per layer, is the success criterion. Step two splits it into a dry part predictable from pressure and a wet part that carries the signal. Step three, pressure, temperature and humidity separately, is the stretch goal. A marker on the first riser shows where the project stands: one layer mean per pass.
svg.text: the success criterion of the paper
2. a dry part and a wet part
dry from pressure, predictable; wet is the signal
over 0 to 83 m at De Bilt:
the stretch goal; needs one more constraint,
we are here: one layer mean per pass, about 16 N-units of pass-to-pass change,
matching the De Bilt sounding in size and, pass by pass, in timing (r = 0.56)
